crossRefs.note: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall make their name perish from under the sky. No one will be…
Therefore it shall be, when Yahweh your God has given you rest from all your enemies all around, in the land which…
Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse…
Yahweh didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of…
“You shall say this to them: ‘The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth, and…
When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
Yahweh says, “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build to me? Where will I…

translations.web: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
translations.kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
translations.asv: Thou wilt pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
